question: Dhananjaya Yashwant Chandrachud has been appointed as the ________ Chief Justice of India in October 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**50th.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Justice Dhananjaya Yashwant Chandrachud:**

 
 
• Justice DY Chandrachud is the **50th** and current Chief Justice of India having assumed office on 9th November 2022.
 
• In **May 2016**, he was named a **judge of the Indian Supreme Court**.
 
• In the past, he was a judge on the Bombay High Court from 2000 to 2013 and the **chief justice of the Allahabad High Court from 2013 to 2016.**
 
• In addition, he has served as the National Legal Services Authority's executive chairman (ex officio) in the past.
 
• The sole child of the **longest-serving chief justice in India, Y. V. Chandrachud.**
 
• He has served on benches that have handed down historic rulings on issues including the decriminalization of homosexuality, the Ram Janmabhoomi verdict, privacy verdicts, same-sex marriage cases, Sabarimala case, and the revocation of Jammu and Kashmir's special status.
 
 
 
• Chief Justice of India (CJI):
 
 
• The CJI and the Judges of the Supreme Court are appointed by the President under clause (2) of Article 124 of the Constitution.
 
• Qualifications for being the CJI:
 
 
• He/She should 
 
 
• be a citizen of India.
 
• have been for at least five years a Judge of a High Court or of two or more such Courts in succession or
 
• have been for at least ten years an advocate of a High Court or of two or more such Courts in succession, or
 
• be, in the opinion of the President, a distinguished jurist.
 
 
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Justice **Sabyasachi Mukharji** was the **20**th Chief Justice of India (CJI) having served from December 1989 to September 1990.
 
• Justice **Sam Piroj Bharucha** was the **30**th Chief Justice of India (CJI) having served from November 2001 to May 2002.
 
• Justice **Palanisamy Sathasivam** was the 40th Chief Justice of India (CJI) having served from July 2013 to 26 April 2014.
 
• Justice Uday Umesh Lalit was the 49th Chief Justice of India (CJI) having served from August 2022 to November 2022.
 
• Justice Nuthalapati Venkata Ramana was the 48th Chief Justice of India, having served from April 2021 to August 2022. 
 
• Justice Sharad Arvind Bobde was the 47th Chief Justice of India, having served from November 2019 to April 2021.
